milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the player must navigate near the white wool cluster (center at spawn-relative [5, 0, 5] inside the sheep pen) and face toward it, confirming visual discovery. Target is the center of the 5-block white wool cluster. max_distance=5 ensures the player is close enough to clearly see the wool through the fence. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the wool, not just passing by.

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind='block') because this is a place/build task — the player must place a poppy flower block onto the dirt in the garden area. The garden spans spawn-relative [-4, 0, 4] to [-1, 0, 7] and starts with ZERO flowers (pre-existing flowers were removed from the scene). Checking for min_count=1 poppy block in this box reliably detects a newly planted flower. The box exactly covers the garden dirt surface at y=0 (flowers sit on top of the dirt at y=-1). Verified in sandbox: the AI agent successfully planted a poppy on the dirt during exploration.
